items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: Did you ever hear any, uh... Any trumpet bass that sounded like Chris Keller?

ctx.x: Why couldn't they catch that? I don't know.

I said probably... Why they didn't... Didn't take behind him, because probably... He had a different... Different healing tool. Uh... He keeps tapping. But, uh... Did you ever hear any, uh... Any trumpet bass that sounded like Chris Keller? Later?
Was it in the wood race, colored or what? What else? What else? I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I said probably...
